授業概要
日本を含む東アジア地域の環境変動・生物多様性・資源利用・防災などの諸課題について、地理学・生物学・地球科学・水文学・環境学を統合する学際的な研究手法から探求する方法について学びます。
Students will learn how to investigate various issues in East Asia, including Japan, such as environmental change, biodiversity, resource utilization, and disaster prevention, using interdisciplinary research methods that integrate geography, biology, earth sciences, hydrology, and environmental science.

授業形態
（内容）
特定の課題等に対する自身の意見や考え，分析結果を取りまとめ，複数の教員や学生の前で発表し，質疑応答をする形式の授業です．
This is a course in which students compile their own opinions, ideas, and analysis regarding specific topics, present them to a group of faculty members and students, and participate in a question-and-answer session.

全体の教育目標
課題に対して取り組み，その結果を発表し，質疑応答に適切に答えられる能力を獲得することを目指す．
The objective of this course is to develop the ability to tackle assigned problems, present the results, and respond appropriately to questions during discussions.

キーワード
授業の進め方
受講者は最低１回の発表（受講者数により１コマ１人もしくは２人）を担当する．それ以外の回では他の受講者もしくは教員等の発表を聞き質疑応答に参加する．Each student is required to give at least one presentation (one or two presenters per session, depending on the number of students). In all other sessions, students are expected to attend presentations by other students or instructors and actively participate in the question-and-answer discussions.
